chunks: And it is narrated from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, who said:
I saw Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام perform wudu (ablution) while he was in the state of ihram, then he took a towel and wiped his face with it.

key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a muhrim to wipe his face with a towel after wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an observed action of Imām Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام while in the state of ihram. It indicates the permissibility of wiping the face with a cloth after wudu (ablution) for the muhrim.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2679 - It is narrated from Mansur ibn Hazim who said: "
I saw Abu Abdullah (as) perform ablution while he was in the state of ihram, and then he took a towel and wiped his face with it."
